THE DETAILS

One jar. Two jobs.

Gentle exfoliation and deep nourishment, together.

Buffs away dullness

Finely ground walnut shells refine the skin's surface.

Nourishes as it scrubs

Shea butter helps maintain skin's essential moisture.

A creamy glide

The texture smooths effortlessly and prepares skin for your moisturising ritual.

THE RITUAL

Two to three times a week.

  1. Apply to dry or damp skin.
  2. Massage in gentle upward movements, focusing on rough areas such as heels, knees and elbows.
  3. Rinse thoroughly.

Then follow with your favourite moisturiser.

INGREDIENTS & ORIGIN

Shea, cared for at its source.

Shea butter, rich in Omega-6 and karitene, brings a comforting richness to this creamy scrub.

For over 40 years, our sustainable shea butter sourcing in West Africa has supported 6,000 women and contributed to the preservation of shea trees and their surrounding ecosystems.
